messages.author: f61de5f78c7e0a18
messages.subject: contour plot for SE
parts:
Dear Phil,

I used mirt to examine a two-dimensional model.  A reviewer asks for a contour plot of the SE. I know that mirt offers the option to plot a contour plot for the information function.  Is there a way to plot a contour plot for the SE?

Thanks a lot,
Nikos

messages.author: 08146071976f553f
messages.subject: Re: contour plot for SE
parts:
Hello Nikos,

I am not Phil but I hope you don't mind me giving a suggestion
I am not sure if this works on a 2-dimensional model, but you could give it a try:

plot(model, type = "infoSE")

You can also set the range of theta to be plotted by adding for instance: theta_lim = c(-3, 3)

Is this what you are looking for? 

regards, Guido

messages.author: 08146071976f553f
messages.subject: Re: contour plot for SE
parts:
In the manual it says for multi dimensional models:

see:
https://www.rdocumentation.org/packages/mirt/versions/1.37.1/topics/itemplot

itemplot(mod3, 4, type = 'info')
  itemplot(mod3, 4, type = 'infocontour')
  itemplot(mod3, 4, type = 'tracecontour')
